{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Socialist identitarianism treats DSA primarily as a space for the self-expression of socialist politics.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist identitarianism measures the success of political work in terms of abstract ideas and individual moralism.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist identitarianism leads members to make decisions based on what impresses other self-described socialists or internally validates their socialist identity, not what advances real-world power and change for the working class.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist identitarianism orients coalition building and recruitment toward already-organized socialists, instead of toward organizing the unorganized.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist identitarianism moves DSA members away from mass work that grows the movement, and instead shrinks it by directing them inward toward increasingly abstract, sectarian, and power-averse politics.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s greatest strength is its vibrant, dynamic, democratic membership model.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s greatest weakness is that it sometimes treats its members terribly.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"If DSA wants millions of people in it, it needs to be a place where millions of people want to be, not one that tears them down and burns them out.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"To ensure DSA has millions of members, it must celebrate, empower, and retain member leaders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"To ensure DSA has millions of members, it must treat staff as a critical part of its team who can help develop the organizing skills of the membership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
